subject: Re: Kickoff: multilingual NMT representation analysis at scale
body: Pre-flight decisions for next week's run. (1) Scope: the grid is frozen at 24 language pairs × 6 layers × 4 checkpoints — Quentin's power analysis says that's sufficient to rank finetuning-regression risk for every production pair we care about, and it keeps the dump inside the negotiated 72-hour retention window. (2) The regression-prediction readout moves from nice-slide to committed H2 deliverable — it went into the OKRs before the June 26 lock as the capacity-planning input for multilingual finetuning. (3) Contingency: if next week's runs slip badly, the fallback is the 12-pair pilot-grid results, which already support the family-clustering story. Csilla owns the go/no-go checklist Monday morning; Nikhil owns the finetuning probes. Fingers crossed for boring infrastructure. — Priya
